config.assumption_status: Pre-outcome sensitivity grid. All Study 2 effects and opportunity rates are assumptions; no participant target is selected.

historical_anchor.smoothing: (opportunity count + 0.5)/(16 + 1); finite planning anchor, not a known Study 2 rate
historical_anchor.population_and_material_warning: Different validation sample and pre-v6 governing rules; revised expert data and a separate technical pilot remain necessary.

config.pairing: Generate a balanced N=200 panel, then retain the first 20/24/25 participants in each shuffled cell for N=160/192/200. Common random numbers across N; no optional stopping.
config.effect_status: OR=1.5 main effects and interaction OR=0.67 are inherited illustrative assumptions, with explicit smaller/larger main-effect and null sensitivities.

scenarios.name: legacy_sparse
scenarios.rationale: Retained from earlier illustrative grid; not an estimate from Study 2.

scenarios.name: legacy_central
scenarios.rationale: Retained from earlier illustrative grid; not an estimate from Study 2.

scenarios.name: legacy_dense
scenarios.rationale: Retained from earlier illustrative grid; not an estimate from Study 2.

scenarios.name: historical_profile_anchor
scenarios.rationale: Jeffreys-smoothed initial expert pattern; sensitivity only, not revised-material or Study 2 estimates.

scenarios.name: historical_profile_half_correct_ai_opportunities
scenarios.rationale: Half the anchor opportunities on correct-advice profiles; error-advice opportunities retained.

scenarios.name: historical_profile_double_correct_ai_opportunities
scenarios.rationale: Twice the anchor opportunities on correct-advice profiles; error-advice opportunities retained.

scenarios.name: assumed_revised_error_recoverability_85
scenarios.rationale: Assumes improved recoverability of C-05/C-06 after clarification; not a validation result.

scenarios.name: historical_profile_high_dependence
scenarios.rationale: Stronger unobserved participant dependence with anchor opportunity rates.

scenarios.name: historical_profile_baseline_50
scenarios.rationale: Lower conditional appropriate-reliance baseline; opportunity pattern held fixed.

scenarios.name: historical_profile_baseline_80
scenarios.rationale: Higher conditional appropriate-reliance baseline; opportunity pattern held fixed.

scenarios.name: historical_profile_main_or_1_25
scenarios.rationale: Smaller illustrative main effects; not a fitted estimate or chosen detectable effect.

scenarios.name: historical_profile_main_or_2
scenarios.rationale: Larger illustrative main effects included alongside smaller ones, not to certify N=200.

scenarios.name: historical_profile_informative_opportunities
scenarios.rationale: Opportunities associated with the participant random intercept; conditional-estimand sensitivity, not just precision.

scenarios.name: historical_profile_null
scenarios.rationale: Null calibration of H1/H3 familywise error and H2 interval coverage.

scenarios.name: literal_historical_rates_zero_C01
scenarios.rationale: Deliberate endpoint stress test. Observing 16/16 correct historically does not establish a true zero opportunity probability.

limitations: All effect and opportunity rates are assumptions, not Study 2 estimates.
Historical expert data and material version are not interchangeable with revised Study 2.
H2 is evaluated by precision and coverage, not rejection power.
No recruitment target or acceptable-precision threshold is selected.
Main-effect rejection rates count failed fits as non-rejections; coverage is conditional on successful fits.
Unobserved profiles trigger an explicitly recorded contrast-reference change, not removal of treatment terms.
Informative opportunity selection is a conditional-estimand sensitivity, not just a sampling-precision scenario.
